clips.title: The story
paras: The peaceful roads around Thendal Grove are threatened by a violent band of Al'Aketh cultists occupying the nearby temple ruins. Dispatched from the Shrine of Akir under orders to harass wayfarers and force recruits into their ranks, these zealots pose an immediate danger to local travelers. Hanaa Nightwind tasks adventurers with breaking their hold and slaying their brutish commander.

Just southwest of Thendal Grove lie ancient temple ruins that should offer quiet shelter to wanderers. Instead, the grounds have been overtaken by the Al'Aketh, an aggressive cult driven by fanatical ambition. Far from peaceful worshipers, these cultists act as highwaymen and enforcers, preying upon those traveling along the outskirts of the grove. The Rangers stationed nearby suspect these ruffians were sent directly by High Priestess Lorthuna from the Shrine of Akir to bully and coerce the populace into bowing to the cult's influence.

Heading the rabble at the temple ruins is Malduko Cloudcrush, a brutal leader who uses violence and fear to keep both his initiates and unsuspecting wayfarers in line. With brutes and newly indoctrinated neophytes answering his commands, Malduko has established an aggressive outpost right on the doorstep of Thendal Grove. By striking down Cloudcrush and scattering his underlings, Hanaa Nightwind hopes to shatter the cult's confidence and send a clear warning that zealotry and coercion will not be tolerated in these lands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.
I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I suspect that seeing a few of their fellows bleeding on the ground will do wonders to dissuade any zealous ambitions these thugs might have had.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It was all I could do to stop myself from going over and joining you from my position here. I can only hope that these louts got the message and clear out of here soon.
Thank you, adventurer. You have the gratitude of the Rangers of Thendal Grove.
